description: This file defines the 'Holiday' entity class for the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes properties such as id, recurring, description, date, length, and operational country, along with their getter and setter methods. It also contains constants for holiday lengths and names, and integrates with Doctrine ORM for database mapping.

classes.name: Holiday
classes.description: Entity class representing a holiday with properties like id, description, date, length, recurring status, and operational country. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes constants for different holiday types.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the holiday.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the holiday.

methods.name: isRecurring
methods.description: Returns whether the holiday recurs annually.

methods.name: setRecurring
methods.description: Sets the recurring status of the holiday.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the description or name of the holiday.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the description or name of the holiday.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the date of the holiday.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the date of the holiday.

methods.name: getLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the holiday in days.

methods.name: setLength
methods.description: Sets the length of the holiday.

methods.name: getOperationalCountry
methods.description: Returns the operational country associated with the holiday.

methods.name: setOperationalCountry
methods.description: Sets the operational country for the holiday.
